h 17 eave: the last course; climb out onto the roof
The 2-block climbing grid (look-bible.md, "The climbing grid"). In the outside plane, odd rows hold and even rows breathe:
a lip sits only in rows 3, 5, 7, 9 ... (h = blocks above the street), with an empty row over each, so the hands always find 0.5 of air.
From the street a standing jump reaches h 3 (apex 1.25 + catch band up to 2.4). Each lip is 2 over the last: ledge-up reaches 2.5.
The body hangs 1.55 under the lip (blue). Shimmy runs along the continuous courses; per-window lips stack into ladders.
